hero.title: Find designers you'll love.
hero.description: Discover shows Top Shops, picks curated for you, what's worth the hype and the deals vendors are running, all from independent designers and tailors.

onboarding.title: Tell us what you like in a minute
onboarding.description: Pick at least three looks you love and follow designers whose work matches them. Your home feed starts from there.
points: Each look you pick brings up more like it
Follow designers to see their new pieces first
Skip it and come back any time

edit.title: Your Edit, and why each piece is in it
edit.description: Your Edit is handpicked from your style, your fit, your budget and the pieces you save, and it refreshes as you shop. Each pick says why it's there.
points: "Fits you", "In your budget", "Trusted vendor" and more
Gets sharper the more you save and buy

store.title: Every designer has a storefront
store.description: Follow a store, read its reviews, browse its collections, and filter by what's on sale, the price, or what's in stock.
points: Collections and filters on every store
Follow to see new pieces first

save.title: Love it? Tap the heart
save.description: Save anything to your wishlist to come back to. What you save also shapes what Qlozet shows you next.
points: Saving teaches your feed what you like

closing.title: Your next favourite outfit is waiting.
closing.description: Join the waitlist to explore independent designers and tailors on Qlozet.
